checks.low-impact-suite: the README low-impact launcher reports the required stages completed
checks.runtime-behavior: the changed user-visible behavior passes its runtime exercise
checks.visual-baseline: the required current-source WPF frames and manifest/sourceBinding are present
checks.release-contract: the release contract and package closure pass
checks.office-live: office deployment receipt, transfer ledger, and independent remote rereads pass
checks.candidate-runtime: the candidate runtime, offline path, and rollback evidence pass

docs.n/aRule: Only mark a check not applicable when the record names the untouched runtime surface and gives a concrete reason.

behavior.n/aRule: A visual check is not applicable only when no rendered surface changes.

visual.n/aRule: Every affected surface, viewport, state, and current-source manifest binding must be listed in evidence.

release.n/aRule: Office live evidence remains separate unless the issue explicitly changes office deployment.

office.n/aRule: The office-live check cannot be replaced by ValidateOnly or a local build.

gate.n/aRule: A candidate or dry-run never satisfies candidate-runtime; it must be recorded as incomplete.
